title: A canned line added to an internal work order loses its prices
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a new canned line for this test with a labor price and a part with a sell price.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, flagged as an Internal customer.
  • Have a new internal work order for this test, work order 1, for internal customer A, in Estimate.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Add the canned line to work order 1.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens.

Step 2:

  • The line shows its hours, the part's quantity and cost, and no price.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11759 (Story 2, An internal or no-charge work order from creation to Close)

  • S2-E1: “If a line is added to an internal or no-charge work order from a canned line, from an inspection or from ShopCoach, its prices are dropped on entry; cost and hours are kept. A labor rate change in settings has nothing to update on these work orders.”
  • S2-E5: “Lines copied into an internal or no-charge work order lose their prices as in S2-E1; lines copied from one into a billable work order are priced from that customer's pricing. Copying a work order does not exist in the product today; if it is added, a copied work order takes its customer's classification and No Charge is not copied.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
